title: Maintenance Count Pounds on the Member Refrigerant Allowance — Repair and Emergency Service Calls
content:
A Comfort Club member who keeps up maintenance adds pounds to the refrigerant allowance on a completed Repair and Emergency Service Calls visit. The maintenance count is the number of completed tune-up visits on the member's Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements record that are counted for the refrigerant allowance.

**Rule.** A maintenance count of three or more completed tune-up visits adds 0.5 pound to the refrigerant allowance pounds. A count of one or two adds 0.3 pound. A count of none adds nothing. The pounds so added count toward the refrigerant allowance pounds before the pounds covered on the call are taken.

| Maintenance count | Pounds added |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 0.5 pound |
| 1 or 2 | 0.3 pound |
| 0 | Nothing |

## Boundary cases

- A count of 3 adds 0.5 pound. A count of 2 adds 0.3 pound.
- A count of 1 adds 0.3 pound. A count of 0 adds nothing.

## Example (hypothetical)

A member with two counted completed tune-up visits adds 0.3 pound to the refrigerant allowance pounds. A member with four counted visits adds 0.5 pound.
